# Membership evidence batch 03 — revised draft and retrieval failures

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**


WorkBuddy agent (AI), historical batch on 24 October 2026. It addressed eight review issues while preserving previous batches. No production rules were adopted or Q1 statistics rerun.

Corrections removed unsupported exact decisions, distinguished inference from official records, replaced some pre-approval non-member proposals with unresolved status, withdrew unsuitable claims, separated planned from actual admission, normalized labels and split corrections into individual old IDs.

Recorded delivery: 148 task keys across 145 teams; proposals cover 30 keys/27 teams and 298 distinct matches. There are 42 assessment rows: 19 member, 22 unresolved and one conflict, with no non_member rows. Task states are 28 partial, one conflict, one not_found and 118 not_reviewed. The 23 evidence records include 16 reused and seven new; the sole primary FIFA item is the reused 2018 report. Twenty-eight structural checks passed.

Documented retrieval failures include obsolete FIFA PDF links, unreachable archive routes, client-rendered document lists, dead legacy CGI links and a blocked mirror. Such failures describe this batch's actual attempts; they do not prove every public route is exhausted or that an archive request requires physical attendance. The historical fifa2.com material was a lead whose official status had not been verified.

Montenegro's 29/31 May disagreement was retained even though target matches fall on the same side of both dates. The archive-request draft was not sent. Human review, primary Congress minutes, production builds and full pytest were not completed.

Read the [independent review](../../../../../outputs/logs/team_identity/batch-review-20261024-batch03/README.en.md) and original JSONL/coverage files for dated decisions. The current study scope is separately adopted in the [identity guide](../../../../../研究/00_数据再次确认/README.en.md).
